from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp,json,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;proof=[];builds=[]
for cc,cmd in [('gcc',['g++']),('clang',['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/opt/atcoder/gcc/lib/gcc/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/15.3.0'])]:
 for typ in ['main','micro']:
  exe=p/((cc+'_final')if typ=='main' else('micro_'+cc+'_final'))
  command=['taskset','-c','6',*cmd,'-std=c++23','-O2']
  if typ=='main':command += [str(p/'final.cpp')]
  else:command += ['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS',f'-DHEADER="{p/"final.hpp"}"',str(p/'micro.cpp')]
  command += ['-o',str(exe)];r=sp.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True);assert not r.returncode,r.stderr;builds.append(dict(compiler=cc,type=typ,command=command,stderr=r.stderr))
  variants=['compact','final']if cc=='gcc' else['baseline','control','final'];hs={}
  for v in variants:
   ex=p/((cc+'_'+v)if typ=='main' else('micro_'+cc+'_'+v));section=p/(ex.name+'.text');sp.run(['objcopy','--dump-section','.text='+str(section),str(ex)],check=True,capture_output=True);hs[v]=hashlib.sha256(section.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  proof.append(dict(compiler=cc,type=typ,text_sha256=hs,identical=len(set(hs.values()))==1))
(p/'dispatch_proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(final_header_sha256=hashlib.sha256((p/'final.hpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),builds=builds,proofs=proof),indent=2)+'\n');print(proof);assert all(x['identical']for x in proof)
